title: Personalized federated learning of gradient boosted trees

pse.problem: Training a global machine learning model across multiple parties holding local data samples without exchanging the samples.
pse.solution_function: Federated learning technique trains a global machine learning model iteratively by distributing it to each party, generating personalized model updates from updated models boosted locally using their respective local data, fusing these updates to produce a boosted decision tree, and updating the global model accordingly.
pse.solution_structure: A system consists of multiple parties, each having local data and a local machine learning model. A global machine learning model, which is initially distributed, acts as a central model for fusion of personalized model updates.
pse.solution_implementation: The global machine learning model (initially distributed to each party) is trained using federated learning by employing gradient boosted trees. Each party trains local models using their respective local data, generates updated models through boosting, and sends these updates to a fusion center for consolidation into the global model.
pse.effect: This approach provides efficient training of a personalized machine learning model without exchanging sensitive local data among parties, thus ensuring privacy and reducing communication overhead.
